title: Equivalent npm pnpm and Yarn projects
expected: Select the package manager matching the native lock and packageManager metadata.
Competing locks are an explicit negative case, not normal fixture state.

cases.name: pnpm-native-patches
cases.change: Build variants/pnpm-patches using its native settings, lock and checked-in dependency patch.
cases.expect: Apply the patch to the captured transitive dependency, collect four passing tests, coverage and a snapshot package. Modified patches with stale locks and patch paths outside the captured project must fail before source hooks run.

cases.name: yarn-selective-resolutions
cases.change: Build variants/yarn-resolutions using its native package.json and yarn.lock.
cases.expect: Keep direct is-number 6.0.0 and use 7.0.0 only under is-odd; collect five passing tests, coverage and a snapshot package. Changing the override without updating the lock must fail before project hooks execute.

cases.name: competing-locks
cases.change: Copy another variant's lock into one project.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
